title: TraySend::Held is kept in step with the attachments' photo_render by release_idle_hold and manual resets
trigger: Press Send while a photo edit renders, then remove the rendering photo or abandon its edit
effect: No bug today: Held is only valid while some attachment renders; update, update_item, end_render and clear_attachments each reset it to Idle by hand, and a failed render silently drops the held text
fix: Derive the held send from the render stage of the tray (one TrayStage enum: Ready, Rendering{held: Option<Held>}) so it cannot outlive the render

title: A DraftClear survives a send that never acks and is taken by the ack of a later send in the same chat
trigger: Send text from chat A so a whole_composer DraftClear is stored, have the message fail with an error after TDLib accepted it, then send a sticker or GIF in A (no clear of its own) while another window shows A with a draft
effect: The sticker's ack consumes the stale clear (take_draft_clear matches by chat id across topics) and clears a draft the earlier send never owned; only an idle composer or another window triggers it
fix: Key the clear by the send's message/request id (Stage::Sent{request}) and drop it on the send's error ack

title: inline_bot_alert_shown is a once-flag in ComposerUi beside the BotAlert stage in ChatUi
trigger: Confirm the secret-chat inline bot warning in the main window, then open a chat window for another secret chat and type @bot
effect: The warning asks again in each window slot although the comment says once per session; the flag is never cleared and lives with a different owner than the BotAlert stage it gates
fix: Put the acknowledgement in the account's OnScreen state (or make BotAlert carry Acknowledged) so the gate and the stage are one value

title: SuggestUi: the emoji-word popup stage is spread over query, word_ready, word_timer, active, selected and dismissed
trigger: Type a lone word that has an emoji, wait 300 ms, press Esc, keep typing
effect: No bug today: Idle, Waiting(timer), Ready and Shown are inferred from which Options are Some, and sync_suggest_menu, close_suggest_menu and pick_suggest_index reset subsets by hand (word_timer = None, word_ready kept or cleared by comparing to the new query)
fix: enum SuggestStage { Idle, WaitingWord{query, timer: Task}, Ready{query}, Shown{query, items, selected} } with dismissed kept beside it

title: screen_preparing is a hand-kept counter incremented before the spawn and decremented inside it
trigger: Start a connection (startup, retry or unlock) and quit or lose the app entity before the preparation answers
effect: The counter is the only thing that stops account deletion while the screen's folders are prepared; it is balanced only if the detached task reaches its first update, so a dropped update leaves deletions refused
fix: A Preparing(Task) stage in ConnectStage held by the owner so dropping the stage releases the claim

title: ConnectStage::Connecting is matched to its detached task by a separate connect.generation counter
trigger: Press Retry twice on the startup failure card
effect: The stage (auth_demo.stage), the counter (connect.generation) and the detached task are three values kept in step; the task cancels itself by comparing generations, not by being owned by the stage
fix: ConnectStage::Connecting { task: Task<()> } so a restart replaces and cancels it

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in the import and add-contact dialog content closures
trigger: Open Import contacts or Add contact and let the kit call the content closure more than once
effect: The first call takes the body and a second call draws an empty div; a re-entrant borrow would panic. Same pattern at line 242
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure or pass a clonable element, no RefCell

title: ImportContactsDialog::pick token sits beside state = VcardImport::Reading while the read task is detached
trigger: Open Import, choose a .vcf, choose another before the first read ends
effect: No wrong result today (the token drops the old answer) but the stage does not carry the token or the task: pick and state are two fields, and the picker task of choose_vcard_file has no stage at all so two Choose clicks open two pickers
fix: VcardImport::Reading { pick, task } and VcardImport::Choosing(task) in the stage

title: ContextMenuItems keeps four RefCell/Cell fields borrowed with borrow()/borrow_mut() in render and key paths
trigger: Open a context menu and press Up/Down while a row claims its handle in the same frame
effect: A nested borrow would panic; each borrow is short today (claim, live, step) but the rule says use try_borrow
fix: try_borrow_mut with an early return, or collect claims in a plain Vec owned by the frame state

title: MenuFocusStage { Closed, Open{previous} } mirrors context_menu_open() which is derived from six other menu fields
trigger: Open a chat-list row menu, then close it by switching account or chat in one frame
effect: The hand-off is an edge detector run only from menu_focus_upkeep; the real menu stage lives in message_ui.menu, chat_list.menu, archive_menu, row_menu, story_menu, playlist menu and tab_menu, so the two can disagree for a frame and the focus is not given back if upkeep skips the window
fix: One ContextMenu enum per window slot (None, Message(..), ChatRow(..), ...) that carries the focus to give back

title: A submenu marked open (menu.submenu) is repaired by the key handler when its parent row was not drawn
trigger: Open a chat-row submenu, change the list so the parent row is not drawn, press a key
effect: The stale submenu state is only cleared when a key arrives (submenu_key_press), not by the menu's own transitions; until then open_submenu() keeps swallowing keys
fix: Submenu open state owned by the menu value and closed when its row set changes (one ChatMenuStage)

title: NoticeGate::shown bool is kept in step with the observer's Option<Entity> handle (keep.take())
trigger: Start Quill hidden in the tray with a pending crash report, then activate the window
effect: No bug today: two values (shown flag, held handle) both say the notice was shown
fix: enum NoticeGate { Waiting, Shown } or drop the bool and rely on the one-shot handle

title: CustomEmojiCard::Shown names a timer whose Task is detach()ed, compared by equality when it fires
trigger: Tap a custom emoji; the card shows and a detached 6 s timer runs
effect: No bug today (the timer re-checks the stage); the stage does not own its timer, so a card closed and re-tapped runs several dead timers and nothing cancels them
fix: Shown { preview, timer: Task<()> } so replacing or closing the stage drops its timer

title: CustomEmojiCard::Asked has no way out and is matched to the answer by emoji_id, not by the request
trigger: Tap a custom emoji while offline or when preview_custom_emoji fails or its pack never answers
effect: Asked stays forever (its send result is dropped by let _ =, no error arm, no timer); a late or foreign preview with the same emoji_id then pops the card long after the tap
fix: Asked { emoji_id, request: RequestId } cleared by the answer or error of that request and by a send failure; Shown only from the matching answer

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the share dialog content closure
trigger: Open the share-link chooser
effect: A re-entrant borrow would panic; today the borrow is a one-line take()
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure instead of take() from a RefCell

title: UI LinkFlow {Idle, Running{origin}, Asking{invite}} shadows the session's ChatsState::deep_link stage; take_origin/resume are paired by hand at six sites in pump_deep_link
trigger: Click any t.me link
effect: No bug today (every terminal state drops the origin), but the origin and the invite copy are kept in step with the session flow by hand, and Idle vs Running is the old started flag beside ResolvingInfo/ResolvingChat
fix: Carry the origin in the session's DeepLinkFlow (stage + origin window) so the UI holds no second stage, and show the invite from the session stage

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the invite and info dialog content closures
trigger: Open a group invite link or a link info box
effect: A re-entrant borrow would panic; today each is a one-line take()
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure instead of take() from a RefCell

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog body one-shot
trigger: Dialog content closure is called again while the first call holds the borrow
effect: panic if the closure re-enters; today it takes the body once and a second draw shows an empty box
fix: build the body inside the closure, or use a Cell take

title: 'Checking' item stays disabled if the member lookup never answers
trigger: Open the direct-topic menu with the member status fetch failing (send refused, `let _ =` ignores it)
effect: Ban item reads 'Checking' and is disabled; retry only on the next click of the menu button
fix: Fetch<bool> for the member status with Failed shown and retried by the menu

title: DiskUi keeps unwritable beside DiskStage; it is derived from the same reading
trigger: apply_data_reading sets unwritable and also forces free=Some(0) so the stage goes Full; the two are written from one place but read separately (disk_full_view, full_disk_notice)
effect: None today; unwritable can disagree with the stage between readings
fix: fold unwritable into DiskStage::Full{unwritable}

title: The disk watcher is a detached process-wide task that applies readings to whichever client is on screen
trigger: A reading started for account A lands after a switch to B; guarded only by note_account_files comparing AccountKey, the `device` and floors apply to all
effect: Wrong account's cache folder is dropped correctly; the task itself is never held in the stage
fix: hold the watcher Task in DiskUi

title: download_row(active: bool, failed: bool) encodes a three-way row kind in two bools
trigger: Callers pass (true,false), (false,true), (false,false); (true,true) is representable and draws a pause disc with a failed label
effect: None today; an illegal state is representable
fix: enum DownloadRowKind { Active, Failed, Recent }

title: DraftTimer::armed names a running timer but the task that serves it is detached in drafts.rs
trigger: schedule_draft_commit spawns a detached cx.spawn; armed=Some means a task runs, nothing holds the task so a dropped task leaves armed=Some and no later keystroke spawns a new one
effect: If the task ever ended without calling step (app entity update failing), no draft would be committed again this run
fix: DraftTimer::Armed{token, due, task: Task<()>} held in the stage

title: One app-wide draft timer holds a single token, but the token belongs to one account's driver
trigger: Type in account A (debounced draft held in A's driver, timer armed with A's token), switch to B within the quiet window; Fire commits against self.live (B) which ignores A's token, and B's first keystroke re-arms the timer over A's token
effect: A's last second of typed draft text is not saved to Telegram unless something else flushes A's driver
fix: keep the timer per driver/account (in OnScreen) or settle the old driver's draft on switch

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut on the rich-draft parser cache from a &self fn
trigger: composer_draft_parts is called from flush_leaving_draft/note_open_draft while a parse of the same cell could be live (rich editor render)
effect: panic on re-entrant borrow
fix: Cell take/put back, as TextLimitCount does

title: The file-drag probe answer is matched by the path list, not by a request id held in the stage
trigger: Drag files over the chat, leave, drag the same files again: the first probe's answer applies to the second drag because paths() == probed
effect: None today (same paths give the same answer); probes are not cancellable and a stale answer is accepted
fix: Probing{request/probe id} compared in the answer

title: A folder-archive drop is dropped without a note while an archive from another chat is still building
trigger: Drop a folder on 'Send as archive' in chat A, switch to chat B before it is zipped, drop a folder in B: `archive != Idle` returns silently until A's zip answers
effect: The drop in B does nothing and says nothing (the 'preparing' note was cleared with the chat switch)
fix: drop-in-B queues or says 'one archive at a time'; ArchiveJob cancelled when the slot changes

title: non-test thread_local RefCell borrow_mut in begin/open_if_ready/take
trigger: open_if_ready holds borrow_mut across start_prepared_live_connect, which opens TDLib; if that path called take() or begin() it would panic
effect: panic at startup on re-entry
fix: Cell<Option<First>> with take/put back
